decision.title: libmpdec arrives in Phase 1
decision.summary: mpdecimal is vendored and wrapped as describes in Phase 1 rather than Phase 2, because the slice needs decimal arithmetic and integer ranges beyond int64_t.

body.p: , amending ("for the decimal packet of Phase 2"). The slice divides and multiplies decimals and builds integer ranges beyond int64_t (), so mpdecimal is vendored and wrapped as describes in Phase 1 (packet ). Decimal formatting and the rest of the decimal function library stay in Phase 2.
